summary: TFI International Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce the upcoming release of its second quarter 2026 financial results on July 27, 2026, after market close, followed by a webcast with management. The filing contains no information about any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a routine earnings release announcement and does not qualify as a special-situation event.
